payload.title: Record one review that labels several outputs
payload.description:
As a reviewer I answer the whole checklist for an item at once and want to save it as one review.

Current: review() takes one classifier per call (embedded_cyclotron.py:667-700); with several outputs, omitting it raises 'name the classifier' (:1022-1029); each call can trigger optimization under the lock (:729, :1083-1092). Related in-progress work: flywheel07 (SDK facade: decide, review, status).

Desired: review(decision_id, labels={cid: label, ...}, explanation=...) stored atomically, one optimization pass after.

Acceptance: one call labels N outputs; partial checklists allowed (unlabeled outputs stay open); idempotent by review_id; test with 3 outputs shows one review event per output and no duplicate optimizer runs.
